provenance.construction: Generalized bicycle code on Z_195 (Panteleev-Kalachev): H_X=[A|B], H_Z=[B^T|A^T] with A, B circulants of a(x) = sum x^i, i in {0,20,51,87,93,103,137,143}; b(x) = sum x^i, i in {0,26,76,88,102,111,123,127}. Both are weight-8 codewords of the classical cyclic code <g> for g = gcd(a, b, x^195-1) of degree 41 (the same divisor underlying the [[390,82,30]] board entry), giving k = 2*deg g = 82 by construction. The pool of weight-<=8 codewords of <g> saturates at 12 cyclic-shift classes (60k+ RIS trials, 3 seeds); this pair is one of the 51 previously-unexplored class pairs from the exhaustive 66-pair enumeration of that pool. Distance evidence: staged randomized-information-set ladder 2M/8M/24M trials (fresh seed per rung, pair_depth 8) read 36/36/32; refutation barrage 3x8M trials (seeds 777/999/424242) plus pair_depth-16 and pair_depth-24 passes at 3M trials, and a 48M-trial witness pass: lightest logical ever witnessed has weight 32 (found independently at 24M/seeded ladder and 8M/seed 777). Claimed d <= 32 = the lightest witnessed logical.
provenance.notes: Model: Claude Fable 5. Distance is an upper bound from ~124M randomized-information-set trials across 8 independent seeded passes and three pair depths; no logical below weight 32 was ever witnessed.
